author: Jurause1
quote: Genuinely worst game of the decade, absolutely does not deserve game of the year nomination. Rockstar should think before they release anything. They charge 100€ for it, launch it console-only so PC players have to wait or download emulators from sketchy websites. A game that costs this much shouldn’t feel like a chore. It needs to be worth the money we pay. MAXIMUM 20€ for the game.
